reason: Dcode is a desktop application wrapper for DeepSeek Harness, primarily providing a graphical desktop experience with an integrated terminal and token-usage visualization.

summaries.zh: Dcode 是 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面端外壳，提供免终端启动、内置多标签终端和用量统计面板。
summaries.en: Dcode is a desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness that provides one-click startup, an integrated multi-tab terminal, and token-usage analytics.

capabilities: Launches a desktop application and its bundled DeepSeek Harness service
Provides an embedded multi-tab shell terminal capable of executing local commands
Reads and shares configuration and session data under ~/.dsh
Displays token usage statistics from local usage data
Checks for updates and downloads and installs them after user initiation
